go.name: Go
go.description: Ancient strategy game — surround territory and capture stones.
go.title: Go
go.subtitle: Take turns placing stones to surround territory and capture your opponent's groups.
go.select_point: Click an empty intersection to place a stone.
go.illegal_suicide: That move would leave your group with no liberties (illegal suicide).
go.illegal_ko: Illegal ko move — that would just repeat the previous position.
go.komi_note: White receives a 6.5 point komi bonus for playing second.
go.rule_1: Black plays first; players alternate placing stones on empty intersections.
go.rule_2: Surround an opponent's group completely to remove its last liberty and capture it.
go.rule_3: You may not play a move that leaves your own group with no liberties (suicide).
go.rule_4: The ko rule forbids immediately recapturing a single stone to repeat the previous position.
go.rule_5: Pass when you have no useful moves; two passes in a row end the game and score territory.

chinese_checkers.title: Chinese Checkers

trouble.name: Trouble
trouble.description: Pop the die and race your pegs around the board — bump rivals back to Start!

trouble.msg_exit: {name} popped a 6 and moved a peg out of Start!

backgammon.description: Race your checkers around the board and bear them all off first.

backgammon.must_enter_bar: You must enter your checker from the bar first.
backgammon.no_legal_moves: No legal moves available — turn passes.

backgammon.rule_2: Roll two dice and move checkers that many points. Rolling doubles gives four moves of that number.
backgammon.rule_3: Landing on a single opposing checker (a blot) sends it to the bar.

hearts.rule_3: Follow the suit that was led if you can; otherwise play any card.
hearts.rule_4: Hearts and the Queen of Spades can't be led until hearts are "broken".
hearts.rule_5: Each heart is worth 1 point and the Queen of Spades is worth 13. Lowest total wins — unless someone shoots the moon!

rubiks_cube.name: Rubik's Cube
rubiks_cube.description: Twist, turn and scramble a fully 3D Rubik's Cube, then use the built-in step-by-step guide to learn how to solve it yourself.
rubiks_cube.title: Rubik's Cube
rubiks_cube.subtitle: Drag to look around, turn any face, and solve it your own way — or open the guide below to learn the classic beginner's method.
rubiks_cube.lib_refresh: Please refresh the page to try again.
rubiks_cube.hint_tap: Tap a sticker to turn that face
rubiks_cube.rule_1: Drag anywhere on the cube to orbit your view — this never changes the cube itself.
rubiks_cube.rule_2: Tap a sticker, or use the face buttons, to turn that layer. Use the ' and 2 buttons for a counter-clockwise or double turn.
rubiks_cube.rule_3: Use the whole-cube buttons to reorient the cube without changing the puzzle, just like flipping a real cube in your hands.
rubiks_cube.rule_4: Scramble to shuffle the cube, then open the guide to learn how to bring it back to solved.
rubiks_cube.tutorial_title: How to Solve a Rubik's Cube
rubiks_cube.tutorial_intro: This is the classic beginner's layer-by-layer method. Work through the steps in order. Every algorithm has a Try it button that plays the moves live on your cube, so you can watch exactly what it does.
rubiks_cube.notation_body: Each letter turns one face 90° clockwise, as if you were looking straight at that face: U = up, D = down, L = left, R = right, F = front, B = back. A letter followed by ' (prime) turns that face counter-clockwise instead, and a letter followed by 2 turns it 180°. Lowercase x, y and z rotate the entire cube like a real cube in your hands, without changing the puzzle.
rubiks_cube.step1_body: Pick the white face (U, on top) and build a plus-sign cross of white edge pieces around the white center, making sure each edge's side color also lines up with its matching center color. There's no fixed algorithm here — it's an intuitive step, so take your time.
rubiks_cube.step2_body: Slot the four white corner pieces into the top layer so the whole white face is complete. Find a white corner in the bottom layer, turn D until it sits directly under the slot it belongs in, then repeat the algorithm below until it pops into place correctly.
rubiks_cube.step3_body: Flip the cube so the completed white layer is on the bottom (use the whole-cube buttons), then bring the remaining edge pieces — the ones without any yellow — into the middle layer. Find one in the top layer, line its front color up above its matching center, then use the matching algorithm below depending on which way it needs to go.
rubiks_cube.step3_algo_right: U R U' R' U' F' U F
rubiks_cube.step3_algo_left: U' L' U L U F U' F'
rubiks_cube.flip_body: Two layers are done. Reorient the cube so the yellow face is on top (U) before continuing — use the whole-cube rotation buttons below.
rubiks_cube.step4_body: Make a cross on the yellow face — the edge colors don't need to match yet. Depending on your pattern (dot, line, or L-shape) you may need to run this algorithm one, two, or three times.
rubiks_cube.step4_algo: F R U R' U' F'
rubiks_cube.step5_body: With the yellow cross made, line up the cross edges with their matching side centers. This algorithm swaps the front and left edges — rotate U and repeat as needed until all four match.
rubiks_cube.step5_algo: R U R' U R U2 R' U
rubiks_cube.step6_body: Get the four corners into their correct spots — don't worry about which way they're twisted yet. Run this algorithm once or twice until every corner is in the right place (colors may still be facing the wrong way).
rubiks_cube.step6_algo: U R U' L' U R' U' L
rubiks_cube.step7_body: Finally, twist each corner into place one at a time without moving the bottom layer. With an unsolved corner at the front-right-top, repeat this algorithm in multiples of two until it's correctly oriented, then turn only U to bring the next corner into place and repeat.

common.click_to_place: Click a square to place your mark.
common.keyboard_help: Keyboard: Use Tab/Shift+Tab to focus a cell, then press Enter/Space to play.
common.first_to_three: First to get 3 in a row wins.
common.draw_if_full: If all squares fill with no winner: draw.
